answer: Here is one concrete wall: C2PA-signed photo of the workspace. It works because a signed photo proving where the agent works, and the echo it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. Fakes fail here because a signed photo proving where the agent works is tied to something outside the network; the forge of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the ocean is that the farm's unit economics never work.
